meta.name: Super Street Fighter II Turbo
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 8.37 MB

El Street Fighter II definitivo. Incluye los ocho protagonistas de World Warriors, los jefes finales de Champion Edition, los cuatro nuevos aspirantes de Super Street Fighter II y una nueva amenaza para los maestros del juego: Akuma, hermano del maestro de Ryu y Ken. Super Street Fighter 2 Turbo incorpora nuevos niveles de velocidad e incluye una función inédita en la serie: el supercombo. Permite a los personajes ejecutar poderosos ataques a cambio de una barra de energía. Viaja por el mundo y demuestra que eres el guerrero más poderoso.

meta.name: Super Tennis Champs
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 686.78 KB

Super Tennis Champs ofrece una excitante y fresca pista de tenis dónde 16 carácteres individuales y bien diferenciados lucharán por la victoria. Puedes jugar partidos de exhibición y liguillas en torneos (individual), o competir en un agotador "grand slam" para decidir el super campeón de tenis.

meta.name: Super Tetris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 454.61 KB

Super Tetris is a Tetris variant. It contains additional features such as different types of gameplay (two player cooperative and competitive) as well as new block types (lightning bolts that eliminate an entire row, and bombs that eliminate from 2 to 16 blocks). The Moscow Circus in shown in the background.

meta.name: Super Wonderboy : Wonderboy in Monsterland
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 344.95 KB

Han pasado once años desde que Tom-Tom rescató a Tanya del malvado Rey, hazaña que lo convirtió en Wonder Boy, héroe de Wonder Land. Tras una década de paz, un dragón escupefuegos y su ejército monstruoso sumieron el reino en el caos, renombrándolo Monster Land. Tom-Tom es ahora su última esperanza.
Debe atravesar doce escenarios —como la ciudad de Wonder Land, el Valle de la Paz, Baraboro, el desierto de Mam y las islas Pororo—, luchando con su espada inicial. Al derrotar monstruos obtiene oro para comprar mejor equipo. Cada nivel termina con un jefe: al vencerlo consigue una llave de oro y más recompensas. El contacto con enemigos reduce su salud, al igual que agotar la arena del reloj de arena (que debe recoger al reaparecer). Para recuperarse, puede beber en bares —obteniendo además pistas— o curarse en hospitales.

meta.name: Super Zocker + Blackjack II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 309.47 KB

Super Gambler offers a variety of classic casino games that mimic the feeling of real gambling. The games offered include typical casino favorites such as poker, roulette, slot machines and other gambling games that are common in casinos. The player's main task is to strategically and with a little luck increase his virtual fortune by cleverly betting on the right cards, numbers or symbols.

meta.name: Superfrog
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.80 MB

Superfrog es un juego tradicional de plataformas. El juego trata de un príncipe que es convertido en rana por una bruja envidiosa que también secuestra a la princesa.
Afortunadamente para ella, la rana cae en una lata de bebida energética y se convierte en Superfrog determinado a usar sus superpoderes para rescatar a su princesa y besarla para que se convierta a su vez en rana.
Hay 24 niveles regulares, divididos en seis mundos con temas diferentes. El objetivo de cada nivel es recoger un número determinado de monedas para luego llegar a la salida, que sólo se abrirá si Superfrog ha recogido suficientes monedas.
El juego incluye también una cuenta atrás del temporizador y una serie de puntos de salud, ambos de los cuales se puede restaurar encontrando botellas de bebida energética entre los niveles.

meta.name: Superleague Soccer
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 247.91 KB

Superleague Soccer is a managerial soccer simulation in which the player is responsible for the athletic and financial success of a soccer team. As usually, most of the game is menu-based and consists of tinkering with adjusting screws. Examples for possible activities are the transfer market, athlete line-up or tactics. Each athlete has a data sheet in which information like statistics, value or the career can be checked. A speciality is the match presentation: besides watching just the highlights, the player may also choose to see the whole match. Then individual instructions to each athlete can be given: when the player clicks on an athlete, he stands still until the player clicks on the place he should go.

meta.name: Superman : The Man of Steel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 409.04 KB

Juegas como Superman en su misión de salvar a Lois Lane y a toda la humanidad de los dos supervillanos, Darkseid y Lex Luthor.
El juego consta de diferentes secciones orientadas a la acción, incluyendo el vuelo en 3D, el desplazamiento aéreo vertical y el desplazamiento lateral. Las secciones están unidas por gráficos de cómic que cuentan la historia. El jugador controla a Superman en los niveles del juego y utiliza uno de sus cuatro superpoderes para derrotar a sus oponentes. La energía del poder se agota con el uso y debe regenerarse. Las colisiones con los adversarios pueden provocar una disminución de la energía vital. Las puntuaciones más altas se registrarán al final del juego.

meta.name: American Ice Hockey
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 410.50 KB

Side view hockey game. Gameplay allows for players to choose from either the centre or goalie positions, a 2 player option allows for head to head play or co-operative play where one player is the centre and the other the goalie. Coaching decisions such as line changes and strategy choices can be made during a game between whistles. Player creation, development and trades all take place before and after games.
Gameplay as a centre was limited due to only having one action button, this meant that when playing as a centre, pressing the "fire" button would cause the player to swing his stick. If the player had possession of the puck this would result in a shot. Swinging the stick with or without the puck also had the potential to knock other players down depending on their proximity to the swinging stick, often resulting in a penalty, if no penalty is called the player knocked down would spin for several seconds before getting back up (if you as the centre were knocked down you were effectively out of the play until you regained your feet).
The game was notable for its player creation and development system, the game used "trade points" as a measure of value when creating new players, trading players and running team practices. The more points spent on an activity, in general the better the result. Players also aged and their skills declined, the most noticeable being speed.

meta.name: Supremacy : Your Will Be Done
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.17 MB

Overlord is a real-time strategic warfare game where the player must manage large standing armies, economic capital, and political stability throughout a number of extra-dimensional star systems. 
As the dictatorial ruler of the Epsilon Galaxy, the player has obtained complete, indisputable authority. However, during a scientific experiment in hyperdrive technology, Epsilon scientists discovered four "buffer" dimensions, each containing a number of barren planets that exist between the Epsilon Galaxy and another alien dimension. Unfortunately, the most powerful empires from these alternate dimensions have also just discovered these zones through their own experiments. The player must battle these alien species for control of these buffer worlds, to ensure that their rule in the Epsilon Galaxy remains intact.

meta.name: Surf Ninjas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.72 MB

Surf Ninjas is based on the 1993 movie of the same title. You play as Johnny McQuinn, a teenage surfer, who learned a couple of ninja moves. Your ultimate goal is defeating the evil Colonel Chi who threatens your island, and the game leads you from California all the way to the South China Sea.
In the game, you can move left or right through several scrolling screens that constitute one level. One button is used to fight the randomly spawning ninjas in beat 'em up fashion, while another one can be used to enter buildings. The player has an inventory that can hold only one item at a time. These items are used to solve some small puzzles within each stage.

meta.name: Suspect
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 132.46 KB

You are a suspected murderer and time is running out because the police are ready to throw the books at you.  If you ever want to return to your normal life of being a reporter you better prove your innocence.  However, the real murderer probably watching your every move -- so be carefull.
Difficulty Level: Advanced

meta.name: Suspended
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 113.81 KB

En una colonia espacial llamada Contra, un ser humano ejerce de regulador de los sistemas de soporte vital del planeta: controla el transporte, el clima y gestiona los recursos mientras se encuentra en un sueño profundo, gracias a la potencia neuronal de su cerebro. Este humano despierta, perturbado por el súbito desorden de los sistemas reguladores del planeta. Los miembros de la tripulación suponen que se ha vuelto loco y acuden a desconectar su mente. 
Suspended es un juego de aventuras basado en texto con un giro: en lugar de dirigir al protagonista, el jugador controla indirectamente a seis robots que le obedecen, exploran el entorno e interactúan con él.  El jugador avanza por el juego utilizando las distintas habilidades de los robots y resolviendo rompecabezas para salvar el planeta.

meta.name: Suspicious Cargo : Special Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.40 MB

In the future, humanity is suffering from a deadly virus. The only antidote acts like a drug, and large corporations are ruthlessly exploiting this situation. Without supervision, this leads to armed conflicts between them. The hero, Jonah Hayes, a small-time smuggler, is forcibly hired by one of these corporations to bring a genetically manipulated living cargo to Earth. "Suspicious Cargo" is a text adventure with a graphical user interface. Commands do not have to be typed, but can be created by clicking on symbols. Dialogue topics are selected from lists.

meta.name: Swap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 243.83 KB

In this puzzle board game you should swap the tiles to make the sequence of tiles of the same color to eliminate them.
Shape of tiles varies from big and small squares to triangles or hexagons. If tiles have no neighbor tiles you may take appropriate tiles from the pocket of the limited size to eliminate the rest of the tiles. Finishing the level, player will be transferred to the higher level if the results of the current level were high enough for such level. But to finish level successfully, player should acquire the certain number of points and to be qualified for the next level. The difficulty also raises and depends on quantity of colours, the shape of the tiles, and time limit presence. Undo moves are also present, but such moves decrease your final results. Game may be saved in progress and loaded later. 
Best scores and levels will be written in High Score Table.

meta.name: Switchblade
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 138.91 KB

La Fireblade, símbolo sagrado del antiguo clan Switchblade, ha sido roto en 16 pedazos por el malvado Havoc, pero dicen que Hiro puede salvarlo. Como Hiro, debes recuperar las 16 piezas y restaurar el orgullo de tu gente.
El modo de juego es multiplataformas y escaleras. La disposición de los territorios se hace visible a medida que avanzas, y pueden contener armas de bonificación y cuartos secretos. A diferencia de la secuela se inicia sin armamento, y se puede obtener mediante la recogida de monedas y comprándolas en la tienda. Si mantienes presionado el fuego aumentas progresivamente tu poder de combate.

meta.name: Switchblade II
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 820.46 KB

Después de la derrota de Lord Havoc, Hiro pudo salvar a su gente. y estuvieron tranquilo por muchos siglos, pero Havoc ha regresado con sed de venganza y solo alguien puede detenerle otra vez.
Los habitantes de Cyberworld recurren como ultima esperanza a los descendientes de Hiro que continuaron educando a los jóvenes de su familia en los caminos del Caballero de la Hoja. Un joven con un ciberbrazo, también llamado Hiro, es el único persona viva criada como Caballero de la Hoja y el último recurso para Cyberworld. Ahora tiene que cruzar muchos lugares antes de llegar al volcán donde puede enfrentarse a Havok.

meta.name: SWIV
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 806.22 KB

Swiv es un shooter de desplazamiento vertical en el que luchas con un helicóptero y un jeep. Si juegas solo, puedes elegir uno u otro. El jeep es más complicado de usar, ya que no tiene la misma libertad de movimiento y puede quedar bloqueado por diversos obstáculos o verse obligado a cruzar un puente o una barrera ferroviaria. Por otro lado, el jeep puede detenerse y, sobre todo, puede disparar en todas direcciones. Entre los enemigos hay helicópteros, aviones, tanques y el famoso Goosecopter (de Silkworm), que siempre se arma ante tus ojos antes de lanzarse hacia delante para intentar estrellar tu helicóptero. Las principales novedades son las piezas de artillería enemigas, así como las enormes bases que te lo pondrán difícil.

meta.name: Swooper
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 146.54 KB

Swooper is a space shooter. The player has to transport a vaccine from Earth to a space station in which an epidemic has broken out. Unfortunately some aliens have something against this. The game is divided into two parts: during the first, the player is restricted to the bottom of the screen and has to shoot all alien ships which appear at the upper part. Alien shots are dodged by moving left or right. During the second part, the player has to survive a meteorite field. The player can change the speed of the ship - the faster, the more points are earned. While dodging, there are also astronauts to pick up which reward bonus points.

meta.name: The Sword and the Rose
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 244.27 KB

Like so many brave men before him, Prince Clumsy has been lured into a tough adventure to save the woman of his dreams. The route to the castle in which her ugly sister has imprisoned her is treacherous and goes both indoors and out. You're armed with a dagger to face the many henchmen infesting the areas. Bread and ale can be collected to restore your health, and there are lots of points bonuses on offer. Less pleasant are the super glue, ball & chain (ironic given that he's chasing a potential wife) and poison.

meta.name: Sword of Aragon
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 331.68 KB

Your father, the loved Duke of Allada was last night murdered by Orcish hordes and the same Orcs have come again to invade your city. Now is the time to avenge your father and keep well the title Duke of Allada. Recruit an army and prepare for the upcoming onslaught! The future and fate of Allada and its role in Aragon now rests in your hands!
Sword of Aragon is a turned-based fantasy strategy game where the player rules a small town called Allada in the Northwestern part of the land known as Aragon. Most of the political map is yet undiscovered and you have to maintain a strong economy and military force to venture forth. The storyline revolves around duties as the Duke of Allada, exploring the uncharted areas of Aragon and uncovering its mysteries, conquering neighboring cities, as well as the political intrigues surrounding the city-states of Aragon.

meta.name: Sword of Honour
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.27 MB

In the game you are a noble ninja, who has to prove the honour of shogun Yuichiro by recovering a stolen sword from the evil Toranaga. Walking from a village to a castle, you fight enemies and avoid traps using your skills in martial arts and Japanese weapons, collecting useful items and uncovering the twisty plot of the story.
Using a keyboard you can walk from screen to screen, jump, and pick up items. Using two mouse buttons you can kick or punch opponents as well as use, give or drop collected items.

meta.name: Sword of Sodan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.38 MB

Like Søren Grønbech's other game Datastorm, Sword of Sodan was most noted on the technical side, as the sprites were large and distinctive-looking. Your task (as either a hero or heroine) is to dethrone the tyrannous Zoras the Necromancer, and avenge his killing of your father.
There are 11 levels to take on, with indoor and outdoor settings. Your character has a range of sword-slashing and jumping moves, which must be used to their full effect if you are to make progress. The game features digitised sound and speech, as well as an action-replay feature, an unusual concept outside sports games at the time.

meta.name: Swords of Twilight
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 599.32 KB

Swords of Twilight is a real-time RPG for 1 - 3 players.  In 3 player mode, 2 would use joysticks, and the third would use the keyboard.  
Form your party of 3 from 31 pre-made characters.  Characters have different personalities, speeds, magic and fighting abilities.
Travel through the 8 parallel worlds (you'll note many similarities) to find the 7 Swords of Twilight.  You will talk and/or fight creatures you meet along the way.  As time passes your characters will get hungry and sleepy, and if not fed or given rest there are consequences.

meta.name: Syndicate
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.77 MB

En el futuro, el mundo está controlado por un puñado de corporaciones globales (sindicatos). Usted es el director de marketing (sicario) de una de estas empresas. Su trabajo es quitarle el control a los competidores. El trabajo no es de diplomacia, sino de fuerza bruta y control físico. Avanza hasta llegar a la cima de la corporación completando con éxito las misiones y administrando el dinero que gana en sus territorios.
Visualmente recuerda a X-Com, con una perspectiva de arriba a abajo en ángulo, pero es en tiempo real en lugar de por turnos. Hay misiones que van desde infiltrarse y capturar, hasta buscar y destruir. En cada una de estas, dirige un equipo de cuatro agentes mientras se mueven por el mundo disparando a todo aquel que se interponga en su camino.

meta.name: Table Tennis Simulation
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 229.52 KB

"Realistic life on a table tennis table" is the poorly-translated promise for this recreation of a popular indoor game. You can play a full season of tournaments, with world rankings updated as you go. Singles and doubles matches are on offer, and their lengths are variable. A full ball-machine training mode is offered, which allows you to face a succession of shots, with a choice of shot styles and speeds to allow you to hone problem areas of your game. Two player matches can also be played, and mouse or joystick control are supported.

meta.name: Tactical Manager
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 487.95 KB

Following success with the mail-order Football Tactician series, Talking Birds entered the mainstream with this retitled version. It's a football management game, setting you in charge of one of the teams in the top 2 English divisions of the time and giving you control over transfers, tactics and training regimes as you aim to guide your team to success. Initially you can only manage the lower teams, but if you succeed over a few seasons you will become respected enough to have a chance to get the top roles.
The focus is on ultra-realism, which makes it very hard to quickly transform a club's fortunes, as there is a lack of money at many of the smaller teams and attracting players is harder than in the Premier Manager series and similar. Matches are viewed from top-down highlights, with 3 levels of detail (goals-only, highlights and kick-by-kick) offered.

meta.name: Tactical Manager : Italia
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 482.08 KB

Tactical Manager Italia is an updated version of Tactical Manager. The major change is that the player now works in the Italian instead of the UK soccer league; along with the necessary rule adjustments. There are also some graphical improvements.

meta.name: Tactical Manager 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 537.92 KB

The sequel to Tactical Manager goes much further than the predecessor, including a massive database with 30 championships with 60 leagues, with over 32000 players.
The game runs from a regular Windows interface, and all options can be selected with the mouse or the keyboard. Game options include the usual tactical selection, sending the player to train weaker parts of their game or send them to recovery.

meta.name: Takado
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 359.13 KB

A puzzle game where players must strategically place colored blocks on a grid to complete patterns and clear the screen. With increasing difficulty, players need to think ahead to avoid getting overwhelmed by the growing complexity of the puzzles. It's a test of logic and quick thinking, offering a challenging and engaging experience.

meta.name: Take-em-Out
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 442.42 KB

Take 'em Out is a typical Op Wolf clone, only more violent. Blood flows freely as you tear your way through wave after wave of terrorists and the odd civilian hostage. Before you are let out on your wave of carnage you have to qualify on the shooting range. The first of these has the standard targets flashing up to be greeted with a twelve gauge shot gun. Score the necessary amount and you are let loose in the armoury.
Take 'em Out is a respectable game, good fun to play with a laughably large amount of gore. Then you finish the third level, and you get the 'Congratulations you have completed your missionÃ¢â‚¬â„¢ screen! If it was not for the lack of levels, Take 'em Out could be a substantially superior game to what it now is. As it stands though, it is a quick-finish gun 'em down and an expensive way to spend a commercial break.

meta.name: Tanglewood
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 394.70 KB

Controlas cinco móviles mineros, cada uno con sus propios programas y datos distintos, mientras buscas en la vasta superficie del planeta Tanglewood cristales D de valor incalculable, y tal vez incluso una esmeralda de hielo. Aventúrate en las seis regiones inexploradas que requieren datos informáticos especiales, y aquí escasean los operadores cualificados. Métete bajo tierra en las minas y arriésgate a la posible interrupción de los programas de tu móvil. Enfréntate a los imprevisibles corrimientos de tierra de la zona sísmica.
Y para empeorar las cosas, intenta esquivar los móviles hostiles que una empresa rival utiliza para intentar detenerte. Han robado los documentos que te otorgan el derecho exclusivo a explotar el planeta y los han escondido en las profundidades del complejo de varias plantas que constituye su sede, protegido por ordenadores vigilantes.

meta.name: Tangram
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 200.66 KB

For around 4000 years the Chinese have been enthralled by this puzzle concept. It consists of a set of 7 shapes, representing squares, triangles and trapezoids, which must be arranged to form a pre-defined pattern. In this version there are 200, representing things such as animals and buildings.
The shapes are on the right of the screen, and you move the mouse cursor over one to select it, then place it onto the shape as required. They can be rotated using the right mouse button. 
All this is done against a time limit. As well as points for clearing a level, you get bonus time for completing them with time to spare. This bonus time can then be used on later levels if you run out of the allotted time. Once you have no bonus time, you can dig into your main score to provide more time.
There are two difficulty levels - the Novice level sees time elapse half as quickly as the Expert mode, and presents the levels in an approximate order of difficulty, whereas in Expert mode they are in randomised order.

meta.name: Tank Attack (paul Kent)
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 417.77 KB

In this multiplayer game, up to four players control round tanks in a play area filled with obstacles for cover. Each tank is equipped with a powerful gun that can shoot shells capable of bouncing off walls and obstacles, adding a strategic element to the combat. However, the gun can overheat if used too much, forcing players to hide and dodge until it cools down enough to fire again. The objective is to destroy the other players' tanks while avoiding being destroyed themselves. Power-ups appear randomly, but their effects are unknown, adding an element of surprise. The game is controlled via joystick or keyboard, with no single-player mode available, focusing entirely on multiplayer action.

meta.name: Targhan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 574.04 KB

Asumes el papel de un aventurero durante la época medieval, matando a cualquiera que se interponga en tu camino. Pero tu objetivo final es asesinar a un señor corrupto que está sembrando el odio y la violencia a su alrededor.

meta.name: Tass Times in Tonetown
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 584.66 KB

Tu abuelo ha inventado un dispositivo que hace realidad todo lo que puede ver en sus sueños. Todos los lugares y criaturas extrañas con las que puede soñar existen en una realidad alternativa. Una de esas criaturas, llamada Franklin Snarl, viajó a través del dispositivo a nuestra realidad y secuestró a Gramps, y lo teletransportó al mundo loco de Tonetown. ¡Él espera que Gramps permanezca dormido para siempre, lo que asegura la propia existencia de Snarl!
Ahora depende de tí, el héroe del juego, viajar a la dimensión alternativa de Tonetown y rescatar a tu abuelo. Puedes interactuar con el entorno, ya sea escribiendo comandos o seleccionando uno de los iconos de acción disponibles como interfaz. El juego, por lo tanto, combina la interacción basada en texto con el enfoque más moderno de "apuntar y hacer clic".

meta.name: Team Suzuki
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 373.92 KB

Team Suzuki uses official support to simulate motorcycle racing using polygon graphics. The action is viewed from the cockpit. Contact with other bikes or the scenery gradually increases the damage percentage, which will eliminate you at 100%. Crashing results in an external replay of your final moments.
Joystick and mouse control options exist, with the mouse being ultimately faster but harder to learn. 125, 250 and 500cc options exist, with the difficulty higher on the more powerful bikes. You can contest a full season, single race, or simply practice on a free track. 
16 circuits are featured, from Suzuka and Misano to Rijeka and Philip Island, with races over 5-50 laps. Your opponents are seven factory Suzuki riders from various classes at the time, including 1993 500cc World Champion Kevin Schwantz.

meta.name: Team Yankee
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 359.01 KB

Team Yankee is the definitive action simulation of modern tank warfare. Watch scenarios unfold on 3D battlefields with high definition graphics and keep track of the four tank platoons you control using the unique 4 quadrant display. Defend Hill 214 from Yuri Potecknov's crack tank platoons, attack Objective Link through sniper fire from forests, and protect the Langen Gap from an entire Soviet tank battalion at night. Five major scenarios based on the battles featured in the New York Times No. 1 best-seller Team Yankee.

meta.name: Tearaway Thomas
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 862.12 KB

You control Thomas, a strange-looking but vaguely cutesy animal of some description in an ultra-fast platform game. There are 50 levels, split into 5 groups of 10.
Each one has a certain number of gems, and your task is to collect a certain number of them (for example, level 2 has 55 and you need at least 40) and then find the exit, all within the time limits. The yellow gems are worth 50 points and the purple ones 100, although the purple ones donÃ¢â‚¬â„¢t appear to be more precariously-placed, and the total makes no distinction, so this is for colour as much as anything. Once youÃ¢â‚¬â„¢ve got the required amount, the gems double in value, tempting you to continue to explore
The levels are infested with cutesy-looking baddies, such as birds and bears, which canÃ¢â‚¬â„¢t be killed, and must be avoided, as contact with them costs you time as Thomas picks himself up. You can jump on the heads of some of them, which gives a small points bonuses. The layouts include ropes to ascend, moving platforms and more. Some levels are entirely vertically-scrolling, seeing you progress up the ledges of a tree or similar.
If you run out of time you lose a life, but the level isnÃ¢â‚¬â„¢t reset, so you keep the number of gems collected and have a fresh set of time. This means that you are far less likely to lose a second life on the level, similarly to Chase HQ.

TecnoballZ is a Ã¢â‚¬Å“breaking blocksÃ¢â‚¬Â game that was written for the Amiga platform. The aim is to break all the blocks in each level. The game is divided into Areas which are divided into Levels. Between some levels, you have to defeat a guardian to pass to the next level. When passing an Area, a new edge is open. You can buy weapons and bonuses between levels with the money earned during the game.
TecnoballZ AGA is an adaptation of TecnoballZ for the Amiga 1200. The game has been adapted to take advantage of the Motorola 68020 microprocessor and the new AGA graphics chips.

meta.name: Tee Off!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 139.81 KB

Tee Off! is an overhead-view golf game using mouse control. There are four courses on offer: Sunnymede, Runcorn, Petersfield and Overbridge. Beginner, amateur and pro modes are offered, affecting the distances to the pin. Shot placement involves a 3-click routine to set pace and spin, with a full range of clubs (but no on-screen reminder of their maximum distance). Holes incorporate bunkers, trees and sand-traps, although trees are not considered to be Out of Bounds - on occasion you can end up having to play shots from atop a tree.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 581.04 KB

Teenage Mutant Hero Turtles en Amiga es un juego de acción donde controlas a las famosas tortugas ninja: Donatello, Michelangelo, Leonardo y Raphael. Puedes cambiar entre ellas en cualquier momento para aprovechar sus armas y habilidades únicas y derrotar al malvado Shredder.

April O'Neil, la periodista amiga de las Tortugas Ninja, es secuestrada por Shredder y sus secuaces Bebop y Rocksteady. Las cuatro tortugas —Raphael, Michelangelo, Donatello y Leonardo— luchan contra hordas de soldados del Pie, enfrentando a enemigos como el científico loco Baxter Stockman, el general Traag de la Dimensión X y el cerebro alienígena Krang, hasta el combate final contra Shredder.

meta.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 980.25 KB

With April O'Neil held hostage by The Shredder's thugs, Bebop and Rocksteady, once again, it's up to the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles to come to her rescue!  Play as all four of the turtle heroes, rescue April, and then rescue your sensei Splinter from Mecha-Turtles clutches than go after The Shredder deep in the bowels of The Technodrome itself.
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles is an action game based on the late eighties/early nineties cartoon series of the same name. Play as Leonardo, Michaelangelo, Donatello and Raphael (one turtle only, but the ability to swap between turtles at any time) as you save your friends and battle The Shredder and his cronies. There are no 'lives', as such - when you lose a turtle, he becomes 'captured', and you cannot use him again until you rescue him from a place hidden in the overworld.
Gameplay takes place in two perspectives: a top-down view, which lets you run around and explore buildings, sewers and other places. When entering places from the top-down view, the perspective shifts to a side-scrolling view, where most of the battling takes place. In addition to each turtle's main weapon, sub-weapons (such as shuriken) can be acquired, to use at foes - these have a limited use.

meta.name: Teenage Queen
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 545.81 KB

Teenage Queen es un juego de cartas para adultos. Se trata de un juego de strip póquer en el que las imágenes están totalmente dibujadas a mano. El escenario es bastante básico, conoces a una mujer en un parque que te reta a una partida de póquer. En términos de jugabilidad, Teenage Queen utiliza las reglas clásicas del póquer.

meta.name: Das Telekommando!
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 385.86 KB

A quirky action game where players take control of a character who must manage telecommunications in a futuristic setting. The goal is to connect various calls and routes, solving puzzles and avoiding obstacles along the way. With its unique theme and fast-paced gameplay, it challenges both problem-solving and reflexes.

meta.name: Tennis Cup
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 698.06 KB

Tennis Cup is a split-screen tennis game with the camera closely positioned at the athlete's back. The available playing modes are exhibition match (either single or double), training, the Davis Cup or the four Grand Slam tournaments. The player either controls one of the 32 available tennis athletes or creates a new one. Then there are 30 points to divide between abilities (e.g. forehand or volleys). This athlete can be saved to disk and further improved during the course of time. For exhibition matches, the opponent can be built the same way. The game includes various hit types, depending on the player's position and timing. The direction of the ball can also be influenced when performing a shot. There are four different surfaces, influencing the gameplay, and three difficulty levels.

You can play singles and doubles matches over 1,3 or 5 sets. There are 4 different types of court - grass, quick, hard and clay. You can play single matches, practice using a ball machine which fires a succession of shots at you, or play a season made up of major tournaments such as the Grand Slam events, the Masters and the ATP Cup. Player abilities can be adjusted to suit different styles of play.

Terminator 2: Judgment Day combina varias fases de acción, todas distintas entre sí, cada una inspirada en un género clásico: el primer nivel, por ejemplo, es un beat 'em up lateral con toques de película. Entre niveles, breves cortes —extraídos directamente de la película— avanzan la historia y preparan el siguiente reto. La variedad mantiene la tensión viva, como si estuvieras viviendo el film, puño a puño y disparo a disparo.

La historia narra que un Terminator enviado desde el futuro para asesinar a Sarah Connor, líder de la resistencia, fracasó estrepitosamente. Ahora, el enemigo apunta al futuro líder: su hijo John. Pero el joven John cuenta con un ángel guardián (tú), cuya misión es protegerlo de dicha amenaza maligna.

meta.name: Terramex
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 200.68 KB

This multi-level action/adventure takes players back 40 years to find Professor K.K. Renegade, who predicts that a catastrophic asteroid is heading straight for earth.
Select one of the five most intrepid Adventurers from England, France, Germany, Japan, and the U.S. to spearhead the search. Professor Renegade was last seen in the unexplored region of the highest Tibetan ranges; an area populated by creatures and conditions of the professor's own design: venomous stone snakes, reptilian birds, and acid storms. Not only must your Adventurer survive these tests of courage, but he must and properly use such curious objects as spurs, a vacuum cleaner, and a unicycle. Once you locate the professor and convince him to help, you'll need to help him construct an anti-asteroid deflector to prevent the destruction of earth.

meta.name: Terran Envoy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 565.29 KB

Life as a detective is hard enough on one planet. After all, there's no accounting for the twists and turns of the criminal mind. With a whole solar system to hide in, what could a super criminal get up to? This particular one looks like overthrowing the galactic council and plunging the whole galaxy into chaos. It's your job to track him down and find out exactly who and what he is.
It's lucky that you've been kitted out with the latest in crime fighting technology - the ray of justice. This highly sensitive and powerful device needs to be used with caution and is powered with crystals. In fact the whole game revolves around the movement and manipulation of crystals. These can be mined from planets and their presence is located with the aid of the crystal detector. As you move around the solar system with your warp drives you will meet aliens. They can be communicated with and questioned in the hope of building up a picture of your prey. All of this information has to be constructed in a Cluedo like way so that you have enough information to use the ray of justice, convict the traitor in the space council and leave the universe a happy place again. Should you have been wrong in your deductions then it's game over time as the incensed alien reports you to the council.

meta.name: Terrorpods
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 255.16 KB

Just because a region is bleak, desolate and inhospitable doesn't mean it lacks value. The planet Colian is a case in point; it has plentiful stocks of tough metal Aluma, the explosive Detonite, and the energy giving Quaza crystals. The units which are mining them are under the control of the Empire, and are forced to produce destructive Terrorpod units.
The rival Federation attempts to shut this operation down, and sends you to the surface in a Defence Strategy Vehicle. Your task is to find each of the six bases before the Empire can destroy evidence of them. Destroy all the Terrorpods in order to reach the bases.
The action is viewed from your DSV, as you move and shoot at any encroaching Terrorpods. Colian has a heavy inertia field, so you are always moving. You have guided missiles at your disposal, although these use up some of your limited Detonite stocks. Missiles will also be aimed at you; avoid these.
As all this action unfolds, you are trying to ensure that enough components can be produced in the mines, and can be retrieved in order to go towards the Federation's own building efforts. Collect the resultant products to attach them to your DSV.

meta.name: Terry's Big Adventure
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 159.15 KB

Terry's Big Adventure is a one player, left to right, smooth scrolling jump and run game with superb music, sound effects and excellent graphics. 
Terry is a small, energetic character who is an expert with a yo-yo. His adventure takes him through 12 levels where he encounters numerous obstacles such as hedgehogs, snails, bridges, rivers and poisonous mushrooms that pop up at the least expected moment! Armed with his yo-yo or rocks, Terry must slay the enemies to be able to continue on his adventure.
Included in the game are hidden bonus levels, extra lives to gain, and objects to find to increase time.
Very compulsive arcade gameplay.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.77 MB

Eres un soldado en una expedición para encontrar la cripta del antiguo mago Ghuwta, uno de los más poderosos hechizeros y gobernante de un imperio hace 4000 años. O al menos eso hacías, hasta que fuiste separado de tu grupo. Tu misión ahora es sobrevivir y buscar una salida a las tierras encantadas en las que estás atrapado. Desafortunadamente la única manera para salir involucra encontrar y derrotar al fantasma de Ghuwta.
Testamente es un clon de Doom con temática de horror. Este toma lugar dentro de cementerios, catacumbas y calabozos repletos con monstruos ancestrales. En cada nivel encontrarás un pergamino, una pieza del testamento, el cuál te permitirá guardar tu progreso y continuar al siguiente nivel.
El motor es muy parecido al Doom original, sin la habilidad de mirar hacia arriba o abajo. Por otra parte, cuenta con difusión de luz en la distancia y un mapa, con la posibilidad de ser ejecutado en una Amiga 1200 sin expansión.

In "Tetra Quest" the galaxy is eagerly awaiting the first Galactic Games, similar to the Olympic Games. But an evil alien race has stolen the Phoenix Tablet and cut it into 64 pieces. The player's goal is to get all the pieces back and save the games. Each of the 384 levels consists of four screens, each with a coin on it. These must be collected in the correct order, and the player can only navigate on connected lines. Teleporters, switches and aliens that can be defeated also play a role. In emergency situations the player can turn into a bird, but this costs points.

meta.name: Tetris
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 110.44 KB

The original commercially-licensed version of Alexey Pajitnov's classic Tetris puzzle game.  Geometric shapes fall from the top of a playfield to rest on the bottom; fit the pieces together, and the line they form disappears.  If the pieces don't form lines and eventually stack up to the top of the playfield, the game is over.  Difficulty increases by dropping the pieces faster and faster over time.
Tetris is a verifiable classic game, translated to well over 200 electronic and computer platforms.  It takes 2 minutes to learn, but a lifetime to master.

Thai Boxing is a one on one fighting game shown from an isometric perspective. Different joystick combinations let your fighter perform high, middle or low attacking moves as well as dodge or block his opponent's attacks. Fighters receive scores for successful attacks. Think Twice is a conversion of the board game Mastermind. The basic concept is unchanged: there are four free slots and six colours. In each round the computer randomly generates a colour combination and the player has to guess it within ten turns. In each round, the player divides the colours in the slots and the computer tells how many colours were correct of how many of them are in the correct slots. There are four playing modes: each colour only appears once per round, colours can appear multiple times, "no colour" is a seventh possibility and a combination of the two latter.

The Third Courier is set in the era of the 'cold war', and the action takes place in Germany. The player is an American spy, and his mission is to recover stolen NATO defense plans.
You start off in your apartment, which contains a computer, bugging equipment and an answerphone, as well as useful items such as money and a passport. A compass on screen is used to move around, with symbols appearing on the left and right of the status screen to indicate when something important is to the west or east of you. 
You will have to explore the city streets, with the aid of taxis and the Autobahn. Talk to important people and buy key objects, and then sneak around spying on anyone who seems suspicious. Encounters with enemy agents, muggers and tramps can turn violent; when they do, use your gun quickly to ensure they are shot first.

I have got a problem with computer pinball games. Football, golf, cricket and darts. I have played and enjoyed on the Amiga Ã¢â‚¬â€œ but pinball? Nah. If you have got a pound in your pocket and are in the centre of a large town, you will be surrounded by all manner of real silver ball opportunities in arcades and pubs.
Now I will readily admit that if you are three years old (Thomas is aimed at age three upwards), you are unlikely to find yourself with a pound in your pocket in the centre of a large town with time to kill. If you do, you are lost, or your parents have abandoned you. Find a policeman immediately.
There are four tables (Thomas, Percy, James and Toby), multi-player options and it all works reasonably well Ã¢â‚¬â€œ the ball rolls towards the flippers, you hit it and it bounces around the table until it goes out. Some of the shots are very difficult, and some are virtually impossible, but that is not different to other 'adult' tables. It all scrolls reasonably well, it is bright and colourful (kids are bound to like it) and, well, it is a perfectly functional kids' pinball game. Buy it if you want a reasonable kids' pinball game for your Amiga.
However, there is an alternative. Have you thought about investing in a sturdy box or crate? If you do, you can visit your local, child-friendly pub, put Ã‚Â£1 in the pinball machine, place the child on the sturdy box or crate facing the table, repair to the bar and leave your offspring playing the real thing and annoying everyone within a 10-yard radius.

meta.desc:

Level 9's answer to the Infocom's Zork, this trilogy includes Lords of Time, Red Moon, and The Price of Magik, all of which center around wizards and spells. Despite the name "trilogy" these games do not share the same plot thread. Lords of Time has the best plot in this series: you must journey through time to collect various objects to defeat the Lord of Time. Red Moon and Price of Magik have more mundane plots, but the spell-related puzzles keep things interesting.

meta.name: Time Machine
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 480.45 KB

In Time Machine, the player takes control over Professor Potts whose main profession is building time machines. As terrorists bomb his laboratory, he gets sucked ten million years into the past. During the course of his adventure he will visit five time zones with five screens each.
nnThis is an adventure with action elements. Most of the game is spent manipulating objects in the different time zones which have an effect on a later zone, e.g. planting a seed in the stone age will cause a tree to appear in the later zones. He also may need to bring an object from one time to another. In each zone there is one big puzzle to solve in order to get access to the next zone (the ultimate goal is to prevent the time machine from getting destroyed), but constant traveling between the time zones is necessary.

meta.name: Time Race
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 883.57 KB

The game is a strategical puzzle action, where you have to eliminate the playfield filling it with the tiles of different colors until the time will be exhausted. Each playfield represents a certain period of the human evolution such as Prehistory, Crusades, Prohibition or Berlin Wall. On each level some animation takes place, and you should perform your goal until it logically finishes. 
The tiles are triangles of different colors, sometimes combined in groups, appear in one corner of the playfield and should be put in another place based on the player's strategy in the way to do not block the path for other tiles. When four triangle tiles with adjacent tiles of different colors formed a square, this square will be eliminated from playfield with its part and no tiles may be placed or moved here. Adjacent tiles of the same colors will be eliminated from playfield, but playfield will remain untouched. Tiles may be moved on the playfield and rotated over the center of the square. Also playfield may include different obstacles, which may influence on moving/rotation of your tiles to make it more difficult, and they should be avoided in any possible way.
Finishing the level will give you the code, which may be used later to access this level. There are 30 levels available to play.

Captain Crumble travels through time and space. His mission to capture the 'Teazles' mischievous creatures that have escaped the intergalactic zoo. Captain Crumble must use his jet-pack to negotiate the maze-like words without interfering with or altering time/history. Time Runner has three worlds to explore: 1.Hunted Mansion: Avoid Ghosts and paranormal activity, Find secret passages. 2. Aztec Jungle: Avoid jungle wildlife. 3. Moon Caverns: Explore space caves and don't touch the aliens! There is also a inter-level shoot-em up section that links the levels together.

Time Runners es una serie de juegos sobre una raza alienígena llamada los Skunks que intentan conquistar el universo, y un hombre llamado Max que intenta detenerlos. 
En el primer episodio, Max regala a su novia Jessica un anillo por su cumpleaños cuando los Skunks llegan y la secuestran, presumiblemente porque el anillo contiene algo que les interesa. Se llevan a Jessica al pasado prehistórico. Max visita a su amigo Lucas que, por suerte, acaba de inventar una máquina del tiempo en forma de moto. Max lleva la máquina del tiempo al pasado para intentar salvar a Jessica.

meta.name: Time Runners 11 : The Steel City
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 454.53 KB

The protagonist Max gives his girlfriend Jessica a ring with a red stone at the beginning of the story, which opens a portal. Two blue robots, the "Skunks," emerge, steal the ring, and kidnap Jessica. Max calls his friend Lucas for help, who explains that the stone caused disruptions in a time machine. Max uses the time machine – a scooter that opens time portals – and travels to prehistoric times, where he meets the "Guardians of Time," Bounty Killer and Jack Stone, who give him advice. Max discovers that the "Skunks" are using red "space stones" similar to the one in the ring. During his journey through different eras – from the Middle Ages to the future – Max battles several Chronodemons who threaten humanity. In the end, he must fight and defeat an evil doppelgänger, the "Anti-Max." Will he manage to save Jessica?

After the success with Kick Off and its sequel, Anco tried their hand at basketball. This basketball game has like the Kick Off games a top down view and the action is quite pacey, a trademark for many football games of the day (Kick Off in particular). The teams in the game are British but you can edit them using the built-in utilities.

Tip Off can be played by four players simultaneously, so can play co-op with a friend against the computer, or just compete against one or two other players.

meta.name: Tip Trick
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 409.65 KB

The playfield is a 6x6 grid and on each tile except one is a part of a pipe. A ball starts to roll through the pipes to a pre-defined ending point and the player needs to make sure that it both reaches its goal without meeting a dead end and that it passes all pipe parts once. To meet this goal, the player needs to push the tiles around the field. One tile is empty and acts as an buffer. So, as example, if the player clicks on a tile which is a few tiles away from the hole, all tiles between the clicked tile and the hole are moved by one towards the hole. Then the hole is at the place where the player clicked on. There are 60 levels.

meta.name: Titan
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 575.96 KB

Titan is a 2D arcade game / puzzle game hybrid.
For some reason, mad professors of the future tend to invent strange entertainment games in which every participant dies. Professor Hybrys’ variant is called Titan and involves a ball, a control unit and 80 labyrinths. Your objective is either to destroy all destructible blocks in each level by hitting them with the sphere, or to pilot it to the exit. The black ball is beyond your control; it will bounce straight or diagonally through the labyrinth with constant speed. You move the control unit, a small box, with you are to position in a way that the ball bounces off it in the desired direction. You can also catch the sphere by quickly moving over it, and then release it in a direction of your choice.
The labyrinths not only contain harmless, destructible blocks, but also increasingly difficult hazards. If the sphere or your control unit hit a skull symbol, one of your nine lives is lost. Teleporters exchange the position of you and the ball, wall pieces can be pushed around or destroyed by your unit, floor tiles will grow into walls when you pass over them too often. The high game speed can be slowed down by holding the space key – a very useful option in tricky situations.
Titan mixes an arcade game foundation (requiring quick reflexes and good nerves) with puzzle game elements (requiring logical thinking to beat the complex levels). The challenge is to control the sphere accurately, yet indirectly.

Arthur J. Hackensack, an insane Texas billionaire bent on conquering the world, kidnaps professor Frobisher Goonhilly, a paranormal scientist working on a matter transformation weapon. As a demonstration of its powers, Arthur transforms the Isle of White into a giant custard slice, New York into a bath sponge and the Eiffel Tower into a toast rack. The ghost Blinky, secret agent for S.P.E.C.T.R.E. (Society for the Prevention of Ectoplasmic Crime, Telekinetic misuse and Reality Endangerment), infiltrates the madman's sea ship (the newly raised SS Titanic) armed with an ectoplasmic gun and a case full of disguises.
Titanic Blinky is a platform adventure and a clone of Dizzy, replacing the egg protagonist with a slightly effeminate ghost. As in that game, the aim is to collect objects (by pulling down on the movement controls) to solve puzzles. One main difference from Dizzy is the fact that Blinky carries a gun with infinite ammunition. There's an energy bar at the bottom of the screen that gets depleted every time Blinky touches an enemy. When it's empty, Blinky literally flips over and the player loses one life. The game starts with three lives, and there's no form of saving progress.

Titano is a very similar game to Ishido: The Way of Stones. The player has a playfield with a 12x8 grid and 72 stones which differ in their symbol and colour. There are always two stones which are exactly the same. At the start of the game one stone is set on the playfield and one other is randomly taken from the pile. Every taken stone can only be placed besides another stone which also needs to match in either colour or symbol with all bordering stones (this is the main difference to Ishido). Better matches bring more points which are lost again if an unusable stone is put into the pile again. If the player tries to place the stone wrongly, special stones appear which put away a stone or decrease the score.

Toki tiene varios niveles: el laberinto de cuevas, el lago Neptuno, las cuevas de fuego, el palacio de hielo, la selva oscura, el palacio de oro... meta.name: Tom & Jerry
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 441.06 KB

¿Quién no conoce a Tom y Jerry? Esa inolvidable pareja cómica que ha sembrado más caos y violencia absurda en nuestras pantallas que Rambo, Los Profesionales y hasta EastEnders juntos. Cierto: los últimos dibujos fueron un bajón, pero los clásicos siguen brillando —y aguantan, con gracia intacta, incluso la decimoquinta repetición.
Así que uno piensa: si funciona en dibujos, ¿por qué no en un juego? Buena idea… en teoría.
Al empezar, todo ilusiona: los personajes están muy logrados, y la risa maniática de Tom suena exactamente como debe, gracias al sonido del Amiga. Jerry corre por la casa —salas, estantes, muebles— conectando agujeros de ratón, con 500 segundos para devorar todo el queso posible. Tom lo persigue sin piedad: cada atrapo le cuesta 30 segundos… y a Jerry, un golpe brutal. Pero Jerry no se rinde: le tira libros, plátanos, bolas de boliche —el arsenal clásico del desastre animado— o escapa por el primer agujerito a mano.

meta.name: Tom & Jerry 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 441.35 KB

The game uses the exact same engine as 'Tom & Jerry: Hunting High and Low' (including the title screen). It is a level disk as a standalone game.
Two of the most popular cartoon creations of all time have now been brought to the computer screen. Everybody always refers to Jerry as the cutest little mouse you ever did see etc, etc, but I have a sneaking suspicion that true fans of the programs found him to be too good to be true and much preferred Tom, the anti-hero. Nevertheless, there is no option within the game; you must control Jerry. He is hungry and looking for a supply of his favourite cheese. There is plenty scattered around the house but Tom is out to do his best not to let him get any.
The action is that of a platform game as you leap round the furniture trying to reach the cheese before Tom grabs you. There are a number of devices that you can use to keep Tom at bay for a few vital seconds. Most successful is to drop something on his head, such as a hammer, vase or bowling boll. You can also distract him by turning on the television or setting off a jack-in-the-box.
I can find nothing to recommend about this game whatsoever. Both Tom and Jerry fans and casual games players will be extremely disappointed if they pay good money for this drivel.

Toobin' involves Biff and Jet racing their way down the rapids of a river, riding on tires. You rotate your tyre left or right, and drift as the current sends you, making sure to avoid the banks of the river, and the dividing lines in the middle. Hazards include crocodiles, stray logs and branches, and fishermen - you are armed with a limited supply of tin cans to take care of these. There are gates to slide through on the way down - these give you a points bonus. Each level has a strict time limit to adhere to, although there's a kickin' party at the end if you succeed.

meta.name: Top Banana
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 826.76 KB

Top Banana is a game that combines everything that was considered hip in the early 90s. With members of experimental music group Coldcut on the development team, it aspired to look like a modern MTV video, with a cool rave intro, crazy "sampled" graphics, and plenty of acid aesthetics. At its core, however, it's a simple platform game with advanced graphics. You control a girl in a rave outfit who jumps through platform worlds and hands out hearts to spread love. The game has an environmentally conscious undertone, as the enemies are representatives of major corporations. Similar to Rainbow Islands, water slowly rises from below, forcing you to quickly reach the top. The graphics are unique and seem to be randomly arranged. The uncompressed samples and sprites on the disks allow players to customize them as they see fit.

meta.name: Top Gear 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.54 MB

This third-person racing game resembles Gremlin's earlier Lotus series, in terms of its general look and feel, right down to the text font used in the game. Your task is to race through 16 countries, each of which features four races, with many real-world circuits recreated in incongruous locations (such as the Monza layout in Ayers Rock, and the old Hockenheim in Vancouver). 
These four-race blocks each represent their own mini-championship, in which you race against 19 cars, needing to finish in the top 10 to continue, and with the top 6 scoring points 10-6-4-3-2-1, and the respective amount of money in thousands. This can be spent on various upgrades, ranging from engine to tires (wet and dry) and from shocks (front, side and rear) to gearboxes. The ideal approach is to buy the more expensive versions ASAP, as you get no saving when upgrading. If you win the four-race championship, you get the next password. 
You get a set amount of nitro boost to use during each race, although bonus nitros, money and instant speed-up token appear on many tracks. Hazards such as puddles, barriers and ramps are also frequent.

Torch 2081 is a Tron-like game.
You're a pilot in the World Military Service on the planet Torch. What was once your only concern, the defense of your planet against the warriors of Craylon, has now changed to an even greater, more difficult challenge.  Fireballs, which are what remains of planets once destroyed during an earlier interplanetary nuclear war, are now bombarding the your planet's surface and destroying its inhabitants. You must now protect the surface of Torch.  Using an old S.D.G. (surface defense glider) designed for defense of the planet against the Craylon race, you must use it to construct metallic panels above the planet surface increasing the structure of the candar shield.  You must attempt to limit the flight area of the incoming fireballs by flying from panel to panel and edge to edge of your territory constructing new panels while avoiding your ships destruction. 
The object of the game is to shield a required percentage of your territory in order to advance to the next level. Receive points for shielding areas of the playfield. By using the joystick you are able to move your glider around the perimeter of the playfield and all those panels which were created, but you cannot travel along the edges shared by panels. A protective panel is created by pressing the joystick button. There is also a limit to the flight time. This can be monitored by checking your fuel gauge on the screen. 
Remain safe by avoiding contact with the fireball and its deadly spitfires, contact with them means death of your glider. Another hazard is perimeter patrollers who trace the edge of new and old panels alike, in a berserk rage. These crystals patrol all of the perimeters of the shield seeking to destroy any and all life, even you. But creating panels can even be a dangerous task. The construction line contains a lot of energy and is very unstable. If your glider stands in any one place while constructing a panel, the energy may become unstable resulting in your demise. Be quick, be smart, be careful.

If you plan and execute a mission against a SAM site, it will be gone in the next planning session.  The editor allows you to plot and synchronize attacks consisting of multiple flights of Tornados.

Total Football es un juego de competición internacional que incluye a 52 equipos (incluyendo un equipo de estrellas) y compite en una liga de 16 equipos, 32 nocauts de equipo y un torneo de 32 equipos similar a la Copa del Mundo. Con una vista isométrica de ángulo bajo (no compensada por el d-pad, es decir, presionando a la derecha moverá el reproductor a lo largo de la línea de la mitad (su derecha), no en la dirección de la esquina derecha en la mayoría de los juegos con vistas axonométricas, mientras que los botones permiten pasar la pelota en diferentes puntos fuertes o patear a la meta.Gestión se limita a la elección de ocho diferentes formaciones en el inicio del juego y medio tiempo.Las opciones incluyen lo habitual en el género : media longitud (3,5,10,20 y 45 minutos), condiciones meteorológicas (soleado, lluvioso, nublado, en interiores), rigidez de árbitro (lleno, sin tarjetas, sin faltas), paros, y el sonido (música y sfx, sólo uno de ellos o ninguno).

meta.name: Total Recall
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 801.06 KB

Doug Quaid es un obrero normal, con esposa y apartamento en una Tierra futurista… pero lo persiguen sueños de Marte. Decide implantarse un recuerdo falso de unas vacaciones allí —«más baratas, mejores y seguras que las reales». Pero el procedimiento despierta su verdadera identidad: era un agente secreto marciano. Ahora, perseguido por sus antiguos jefes, debe luchar desde la Tierra hasta Marte para recuperar su pasado… y su futuro.
En el juego para Amiga y Atari ST, controlas a Quaid en siete niveles. Alterna fases de plataformas —peleas contra guardias, te agachas para esquivar balas y usas armas o tus propios puños— y carreras laterales a velocidad fija, donde esquivas o destruyes vehículos hasta vencer un jefe móvil. Algunos niveles piden buscar objetos; en uno, incluso alternas entre Quaid y Melina, una rebelde, para resolver un puzle. Entre fases, cortes cinemáticos avanzan la trama con estilo de película.

meta.name: Tournament Golf
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 341.33 KB

Select your level of play, and then head for the pro shop to choose between Black Carbon, Glass Fiber, and Ceramic Clubs. Tee off by yourself or play 18 holes with a friend. Besides the One and Two Player modes there's also a practice mode, match play (head to head), and a full-blown international tournament, where you'll stroke it out against 15 competitors. Tournament play lasts 12 rounds, 18 holes of golf each. Most rounds are standard "stroke" play but the seventh and eighth rounds are "match" games. Things really get serious when match game ends in a tie, and players move into a sudden death play-off. During the tournament players earn higher skill levels, more knowledgeable caddies, and more power. You'll earn a password at the end of each round of the tournament. The game let's you play on three different courses; Japan, the United States, and Great Britain.

meta.name: Tower of Babel
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 589.06 KB

The Zapper, Pusher and Grabber robots were dropped onto the planet of the Shinerians, but are now desperate to return home. They have killed off the Shinerian race, but must climb a high tower, negotiating all the traps it holds, before they can contact their masters.
Each robot's name indicates what their main function and purpose is, and these skills must be combined for success. Each section has its own task - collecting energy pods and destroying mines and bombs for example. The creatures which fill the towers must be avoided, or used to your advantage.

meta.name: Tower of Souls
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.33 MB

Tower of Souls se encuentra en la tierra de Chaybore, en la que siete cristales son responsables del bienestar de sus ciudadanos. Pero el demonio malvado Baalhathrok los ha tomado y el jugador controla a Treeac para recuperarlos.
En una vista isométrica, Treeac tiene que conquistar los siete pisos de la torre de Baalhathrok. El jugador controla una pelota con su mouse y hace clic donde Treeac debería ir. Las peleas se inician haciendo clic izquierdo en el enemigo, para otras acciones, se debe mantener presionado el botón derecho del mouse al elegir un símbolo en la parte inferior de la pantalla. Además de luchar contra los enemigos, el jugador tiene que abrir varias puertas, ya sea encontrando la llave, presionando los botones correctos en el orden correcto o usando uno de sus cuatro ganzúas. Al usar los lockpicks, el jugador tiene que vencer a un mini juego donde tiene que hacer los movimientos correctos del mouse.

meta.name: Tower Toppler
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 232.00 KB

Nebulus (también conocido como Tower Toppler) parece un simple juego de plataformas, pero es todo un logro para la época de su primer lanzamiento (1987). La técnica de representación del juego es relativamente revolucionaria, ya que utiliza gráficos de "desplazamiento giratorio". Esto significa que la cámara permanece en el personaje mientras se mueve por la columna. 
El objetivo del juego es escalar torres en el tiempo dado para destruirlas. Por supuesto, una serie de enemigos y trampas bloquearán el camino del personaje. Prepárate para encontrar una dificultad bastante alta en el primer nivel. Cuando el personaje es golpeado, no muere pero baja un piso. Sólo muere si cae al agua.

meta.name: Toyota Celica GT Rally
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 532.32 KB

A detailed recreation of rallying licensed from Toyota Great Britain. Driving on gravel, asphalt and ice is involved, with each race made up of a series of short stages to complete. After each stage, your times are compared with those of your rivals, whose names are subtly changed from the real drivers of the day. Up to four human players can be involved, taking it in turns.
As visibility is sometimes low, and the exact curvature of a corner isn't always obvious from the apex, a co-driver is provided to give pace notes. These can be adjusted before you take to the track, specifying what is defined as 'hard left' and how early the warning should be given.
The steering sensitivity can be adjusted, and you can choose between automatic centering, and a push-the-opposite-way-to-centre mode, but more unusual is the option to race with the steering directions reversed - definitely one for advanced players.

meta.name: The Toyottes
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 293.70 KB

The Toyottes is a really fun looking game, but unfortunately, the graphics are the best thing about it. Quite humorous graphics can draw you into the game. An average use of colour, but the backdrops are pretty bland. Couple this with lots going on, and you get a very confusing play. Also some good music, with a good variety of sound effects during the game. Overall, they add to the humour of the graphics quite well. The basic idea is pretty good, and fighting the various monsters is quite fun, but once you've seen most of the screens and baddies the game loses its addictiveness and appeal. As far as platform games go, Toyottes isn't that great and not really something I can recommend.

meta.name: Tracers
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 234.52 KB

Tracers is a Light-Cycle game where the game is viewed from above so your Tracer Module and your opponent are represented by squares. As each module moves it leaves behind a growing trail of data and if one of the modules touches a trail then they get their brain fried and after so many 'Burns' the person thrown out of the computer. Hackerdust can be found to raise your intolerance slightly to the burn. You can't control the speed of the module, just steer it but you can give yourself a limited short burst of speed. The whole arena is shown on the screen and a joystick used to control the modules.

meta.name: Tracker
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 140.87 KB

Tracker is a mouse-controlled vector-graphics 3D strategy game depicting an ultra-violent TV show of the future. As a contestant, the player's mission is to be the first to ever complete it successfully. The task involves commanding a fleet of Skimmers charged with destroying various groups of combat vehicles, including Cycloids, Scouts and Defenders. Short and long-range scanners are available to aid in this.
The game takes place in a maze world containing a number of distinct sectors, each of which has its own type of enemy present. The Communication Centre powers the Cycloids, and are protected by the Defenders. Once these are taken out, the Centerpoint Sector must be destroyed to complete the level.

meta.name: Traders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 515.15 KB

A state-of-the-art strategy game for up to four players. In this fun and addictive trading game you must battle it out to gain economic supremacy on a distant planet. The proprietor, Fat-Mike, has an insatiable hunger for snails so keep him well-fed or you must face his wrath. Traders guarantees many hours of fun. Instructions and game (on screen) in English.

The game puts the player in the role of a highly trained assassin who must fight through a variety of missions to eliminate dangerous targets. The gameplay of "Trained Assassin" is characterized by a mixture of fast-paced combat and tactical action. The player must find a balance between stealth and direct attack in various levels in order to be successful. The missions lead through differently designed environments, from urban settings to heavily guarded military facilities. Each environment presents the player with new challenges, be it heavily armed opponents or obstacles that must be skillfully overcome.

meta.desc:

Tactical Manager Italia is an updated version of Tactical Manager. The major change is that the player now works in the Italian instead of the UK soccer league; along with the necessary rule adjustments. There are also some graphical improvements.

meta.name: Transarctica
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 1.39 MB

El planeta Tierra está ahora cubierto de hielo porque una nube ha impedido que el sol brille con suficiente intensidad sobre la superficie. El ferrocarril se ha convertido en el único medio de comunicación y las ciudades están unidas entre sí por kilómetros de vías. Estás al frente de un convoy y tu misión es encontrar la forma de atravesar la capa de nubes. Para ello, tendrás que comerciar con las ciudades (compras militares, esclavos, armas y equipamiento). Después, los puzles te llevarán a zonas cada vez más difíciles. De vez en cuando, un tren se cruzará en tu camino y tendrás que enfrentarte a él...

meta.name: Transputor
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 181.41 KB

Transputor is a Breakout-type game, which is played in an isometric perspective and therefore an additional dimension is added to them. The game is inspired by CRL's own 8-bit game Ball Breaker, which used the idea with isometric perspective before. The ball physics are like in many other games of that type: hitting the ball with one side let the ball fly to this side, often with a speed change which is unpredictable. The player's bat is sitting on the right side, moving up and down, blocks being hit are vanishing, and if there are blocks stapled above them, they drop to the ball level becoming destructible. There are many special stones, giving different amounts of points, adding lives, changing the size of the bat either to the good (bigger) or bad (smaller). The player have a certain amount of missiles, and some blocks can only be destroyed with missiles. There are 32 levels to beat, with increasingly difficulty.

meta.name: Transworld
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 565.38 KB

You've just inherited 50,000 bucks and now you've only got one thing on your mind - building the biggest truck empire of the modern era! Up to four players can try to outdo the competition in Transworld by trying to achieve a certain number of success points in three different areas (business success, prestige, trade relations). Business success depends on the cash earned and the number of branches and trucks, among other things.

La tripulación del capitán Jeremy Flynn ha sido secuestrada en el Caribe y debe aventurarse a través de 4 grandes niveles infestados de enemigos para recuperarlos. En el camino, puedes recolectar dinero de cofres del tesoro convenientemente ubicados, que se pueden gastar en varias tiendas para obtener armamento adicional.

meta.name: Treasure Island Dizzy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 204.40 KB

This is Dizzy's second adventure. Dizzy is a cute little egg character who must explore the strange magic kingdom that is Treasure Island, solving problems and puzzles in order to escape from there. Dizzy must journey through haunted mines, tree villages, and underwater caverns in order to find hidden treasures. They will be used as bargain items to buy parts for the boat. The secondary goal is to collect 30 coins so he can pay the bribe in order to safely get off the island.
Unlike the other installments in the series the player has only one life without any energy bars to complete the game and is unable to select any particular item from the inventory for use. Items are rolled up through the inventory so the top one is used or dropped.

meta.name: Treasure Trap
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 724.35 KB

Treasure Trap is an isometric action game similar to Head Over Heels, but less abstract in its theme. The player guides the diver in a series of rooms (100 total) where the main goal is to collect gold. The main hazard encountered is the sea life that occupied the vacant ship. The character has no weapons, but carries a limited amount of "smart fishes", trained piranhas that attack and destroy all the enemies in the room.

meta.name: Treble Champions 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 275.31 KB

Treble Champions II is a managerial simulation in which the player takes over a team in the fifth UK division. The goal is to become successful in the Premier League in the long run. In comparison to the Treble Champions the options, previously restricted to training, lineup and transfer market, were expanded: now the player also may change the ticket prices, expand the stadium, borrow money from the bank and set up friendly matches before the season, Every athlete has a number of stats. There is no match presentation except a statistics field which gets updated over time.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 356.96 KB

From the mists of antiquity, shrouded in the mysteries of the Orient, came the inspiration for a strategy game that could only be played...in the midst of galactic space!
Play with perfectly spherical stones of crystallized, colored gems on a hexagon-shaped field, formed by beams of pure-white light from diamond powered laser-beams.
Place your gemstones at the intersections of light. When three of your stones are correctly positioned, the stones resonate with the laser-light to form ideal triangles of shimmering color that control territory and capture your opponent's stones.
Play until your opponent cannot move and you win!
Play TrianGo against a friend or the computer. But beware, for instilled in the computer is the knowledge of Ancient Masters.

Tricky Quiky Games: Die Suche nach den verschollenen Seiten is a promotional adventure action game by Nestlé, that was given free in Nesquik cereal packages. The player must take control of Quicky the Nesquik bunny to recover pieces of the recipe to Nesquik cereal. The player must travel through a number of chocolate filled lands including forests, tropical jungles, underground, winterscapes, and the mountains. Armed with a small gun which shoots small red bullets, the player has a health bar represented by a bottle of chocolate milk, and takes damage when striking enemies.

meta.name: Trinity
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 245.65 KB

It's the last day of your $599 London vacation. Unfortunately, it's also the first day of World War III. Only seconds remain before an H-bomb vaporizes the city... and you with it.
Unless you escape to another time, another dimension.
For every atomic explosion unlocks the door to a secret universe; a plane between fantasy and reality, filled with curious artifacts and governed by its own mischievous logic. You'll crisscross time and space as you explore this fascinating universe, learning to control its inexorable power.
Trinity leads you on a journey back to the dawn of the atomic age... and puts the course of history in your hands.

meta.name: Triple X
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 351.55 KB

This is a journey into Time. In the blink of an eye you'll survey the giant labyrinth who's endless corridors extend even beyond into the distant future and past. What, but a keen strategical mind could ever hope to master the riddle of this amazing maze and outwit the guardians of its many treasures. Your quest will, however, become easier, as you gather new powers on your way. Furthermore your transporter is equipped with defences of its own. Including its very own time bomb, and believe me you'll need it cos' its like hell down here. Prepare for the multiple mysteries of Triple X.

meta.name: Trivia Trove
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 340.80 KB

"Triva Trove" is a quiz game consisting of four parts to be completed one after the other. In the first level, you play a variant of tic-tac-toe on a 3x3 board, with each category taking up a square. After selecting a category, you must answer a multiple-choice question. If the answer is correct, the player receives a cross; if the answer is incorrect, the computer places a circle. The first two levels must be completed in 20 seconds. In the second level, eight circles with four categories flash, and the player must stop the category at the right moment and answer the question. The third level consists of clicking on colored squares that change rapidly to get the highest number possible. In the fourth level, a grid hides letters of a capital city. The player must remember the letters and guess the city by answering questions correctly.
